conventions.axes: +X = character LEFT, +Y = up, -Z = facing direction. Verified from 左腕 at x=+1.577 and 右腕 at x=-1.573.
conventions.units: MMD units; character ~20 units tall, 1 unit ~= 8 cm.
conventions.join_key: name_e holds the untouched UE flex name and is the ONLY stable join key. Resolve every group member by name_e, never by the Japanese name.
conventions.file_order_rule: final_morphs is given in the exact order the morphs must appear in the PMX file. Every group morph appears AFTER all of its members, so a forward-only evaluator is safe.
conventions.visibility_rule: A morph is shown in MMD only if it is listed in expression_frame_order. Morphs with in_expression_frame=false stay in the file (they are group members / archival source data) but are hidden from the MMD expression UI.

action_semantics.rename: existing vertex morph, only `name` changes (name_e/offsets untouched)
action_semantics.group: NEW morph_type 0 group morph built from the listed members
action_semantics.new: NEW morph_type 1 vertex morph, BAKED as sum(member_offsets * weight); used where a weight is negative so no tool has to honour negative group weights

final_morphs.name: 真面目
final_morphs.rationale: Inner brow -0.075 / outer -0.027: flattened, level brow. Reference model uses the same name for the same flex.

final_morphs.name: 困る
final_morphs.rationale: Inner end +0.029 up, outer end -0.127 down = textbook troubled brow. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: にこり
final_morphs.rationale: Gentle arch (mid +0.016, ends -0.02). Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: 怒り
final_morphs.rationale: Inner end -0.143 down, outer -0.025 = angry V. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: 眉びっくり
final_morphs.rationale: Arched raise (inner +0.034 -> outer +0.107). Non-standard extra; not a plain 上.

final_morphs.name: 眉喜び
final_morphs.rationale: Small mid-brow lift. Non-standard extra.

final_morphs.name: 眉疑い
final_morphs.rationale: Inner +0.038 / outer -0.067, sceptical tilt. Non-standard extra.

final_morphs.name: 眉悪い
final_morphs.rationale: Near-duplicate of 怒り (inner -0.132). Non-standard extra.

final_morphs.name: 眉疲れ
final_morphs.rationale: Outer droop -0.118. Non-standard extra.

final_morphs.name: 眉考え
final_morphs.rationale: Uniform slight lower. Non-standard extra.

final_morphs.name: 眉軽蔑
final_morphs.rationale: Only 81 offsets (asymmetric source). Non-standard extra.

final_morphs.name: 左眉上下
final_morphs.rationale: Pure +Y translation of the CHARACTER-LEFT brow (all motion at +X, uniform dY=+0.1485). Helper for 上/下; hidden from the expression frame.

final_morphs.name: 右眉上下
final_morphs.rationale: Pure +Y translation of the CHARACTER-RIGHT brow (all motion at -X, uniform dY=+0.1485). Helper for 上/下; hidden.

final_morphs.name: 眉回転左
final_morphs.rationale: Was 眉回転１. Rotates the CHARACTER-LEFT brow only (all motion at +X): inner end -0.0726, outer end +0.0641. Helper for 眉頭左; hidden.

final_morphs.name: 眉回転右
final_morphs.rationale: Was 眉回転２. Same rotation on the CHARACTER-RIGHT brow (all motion at -X). Helper for 眉頭右; hidden.

final_morphs.name: 上
final_morphs.rationale: Both brows raised uniformly by +0.1485 MMD units (~1.2 cm). EB_UD_L/R are verified pure +Y translations of one brow each (dY constant across all four |x| bins), so summing them gives a clean symmetric raise.

final_morphs.name: 下
final_morphs.rationale: Both brows lowered, baked as a vertex morph. CORRECTED after verification: the original -1.0 weights mechanically negated a flex authored only for the +Y direction and pushed the brow geometry into the eyelashes - the neutral brow/lash clearance is 0.1269 units and a full -0.1485 closes it. At -0.5 the drop is -0.0743 per brow vertex, leaving 0.0661 of clearance (about half the neutral gap) while still reading as a clear lowered brow.

final_morphs.name: 眉頭左
final_morphs.rationale: EB_Rotate_01 acts on the CHARACTER-LEFT brow only and at +1 rotates it inner-end-DOWN (-0.0726) / outer-end-UP (+0.0641). MMD 眉頭N raises the inner end, so the sign is inverted and baked as a vertex morph. Confidence is moderate because 眉頭 conventions vary between model authors.

final_morphs.name: 眉頭右
final_morphs.rationale: Same as 眉頭左 on the CHARACTER-RIGHT brow (EB_Rotate_02 is confirmed -X only).

final_morphs.name: まばたき
final_morphs.rationale: Both eyes fully closed (lid gap 0.1090 -> -0.0057, i.e. lids cross). Reference uses the same name for the same flex.

final_morphs.name: 笑い
final_morphs.rationale: Both eyes curved-closed, gap 13% of neutral, upward lid curve. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: ウィンク
final_morphs.rationale: Was 笑い右 and it was on the wrong side. Measured: 100% of the motion is at +X = the CHARACTER-LEFT eye, closing in a smiling curve (gap 20%). MMD ウィンク is the left eye. Reference maps this exact flex to ウィンク.

final_morphs.name: ウィンク右
final_morphs.rationale: Was 笑い左. 100% of the motion is at -X = the CHARACTER-RIGHT eye. UE "l"/"r" here are screen-side, i.e. mirrored from MMD. Reference maps this exact flex to ウィンク右.

final_morphs.name: ウィンク２
final_morphs.rationale: Was ウィンク左, a name no VMD ever drives. 100% at +X = CHARACTER-LEFT eye, plain (non-smiling) close - exactly what ウィンク２ means. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: ｳｨﾝｸ２右
final_morphs.rationale: Was ウィンク右. 100% at -X = CHARACTER-RIGHT eye, plain close. Half-width katakana spelling copied verbatim from the reference model / MMD convention.

final_morphs.name: びっくり
final_morphs.rationale: Lid gap 121% of neutral, cos(-0.91) with まばたき = eyes opened wide. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: じと目
final_morphs.rationale: Was 疲れ目開. Lid gap 73%, cos 0.86 with まばたき = half-lidded stare. Reference maps this exact flex to じと目.

final_morphs.name: ｷﾘｯ
final_morphs.rationale: Was 怒り目開. Lid gap 108%, cos 0.41 with 目尻上 and -0.71 with 悲しみ目開 = sharp, raised outer corners. Reference maps this exact flex to ｷﾘｯ (half-width ｯ).

final_morphs.name: ｷﾘｯ2
final_morphs.rationale: Was 悪い目開. Non-standard, but the reference model uses exactly this name for exactly this flex, so the users own expression presets will line up.

final_morphs.name: 目を細める
final_morphs.rationale: Was 悲しみ目開. cos 0.84 with 目尻下 = drooping outer corners. Non-standard, kept because the reference model names this exact flex 目を細める.

final_morphs.name: 瞳小
final_morphs.rationale: Scales the pupil quad from w0.2757/h0.2785 to w0.0827/h0.0835 (30%) and the highlight to 30%. Touches only 瞳 + 目HL. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: ハイライト消
final_morphs.rationale: Translates the 164 目HL vertices +0.1485 in Z, i.e. behind the pupil, hiding them. Shape is unchanged. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: ハイライト上
final_morphs.rationale: Moves 目HL +0.0295 Y. Extra.

final_morphs.name: ハイライト左
final_morphs.rationale: Moves 目HL -0.021 X (toward character-right, despite the name). Extra.

final_morphs.name: 目上
final_morphs.rationale: Lower lid +0.0097 Y, 270 verts. Extra.

final_morphs.name: 目下
final_morphs.rationale: Upper lid down, gap 78%. cos 0.99 with 真剣目 - the two are nearly the same shape.

final_morphs.name: 目尻上
final_morphs.rationale: Outer eye corner up. Useful group member.

final_morphs.name: 目尻下

final_morphs.name: 軽蔑目

final_morphs.name: なごみ
final_morphs.rationale: A softened 笑い (65%) plus a slight outer-corner droop. There is no dedicated relaxed-eye flex; this is the safest composition because 笑い and 目尻下 are only cos 0.47 correlated, so they add real shape rather than just scaling. If it reads badly, fall back to group[EL_Smile_01_CLO 0.70] alone.

final_morphs.name: はぅ
final_morphs.rationale: Fully closed eyes with the outer corners pulled down = the distressed >< read. TD_EyesClo was the obvious candidate but is unusable (see dropped list).

final_morphs.name: あ
final_morphs.rationale: Phoneme flex authored by the source artist. Lower-lip centre -0.0421 Y, largest plain jaw drop of the vowel set. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: い
final_morphs.rationale: Phoneme flex. Lower-lip -0.0118, cos -0.86 with 下唇巻き = lower lip unrolls/flattens. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: う
final_morphs.rationale: Phoneme flex: lower lip -0.0221 and the only vowel that NARROWS the corners (-0.0024). NOTE the reference model instead maps う to mouthFunnel; jawOpen_wu is preferred here because it is the artist-named "wu" shape and carries the jaw drop that a lip-sync う needs. mouthFunnel is kept separately as 口漏斗.

final_morphs.name: え
final_morphs.rationale: Phoneme flex. Lower-lip -0.0068, wide-ish. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: お
final_morphs.rationale: Phoneme flex. Lower-lip -0.0362, rounded. Reference agrees.

final_morphs.name: あ2
final_morphs.rationale: Was 口開け. Raw jaw-open, cos 0.97 with あ but smaller. The reference model names this exact flex あ2, so keep that name for preset compatibility.

final_morphs.name: ワ
final_morphs.rationale: Was 喜び口開. Open mouth (-0.0260) with corners UP (+0.0073) and slightly wider (+0.0026) = the MMD ワ shape. The reference model maps this exact flex to ワ.

final_morphs.name: にやり
final_morphs.rationale: Was 悪い口開. The only flex that raises the corners (+0.0057) AND widens them (+0.0118) while barely opening the jaw (-0.0056): a closed smirk. 6.9% left/right asymmetry, which is desirable for にやり.

final_morphs.name: にっこり
final_morphs.rationale: Was 笑顔口開. Perfectly symmetric, corners +0.0041, jaw only -0.0052 = soft closed smile. Weaker and rounder than にやり (cos 0.87 between them).

final_morphs.name: 口すぼめ
final_morphs.rationale: Pure lip purse, cos -0.02 with jawOpen. Genuinely independent shape.

final_morphs.name: 口漏斗
final_morphs.rationale: Lip funnel, +0.0071 forward protrusion. Independent shape.

final_morphs.name: 上唇巻き
final_morphs.rationale: Upper lip roll-in. Tiny (max 0.0105) but independent.

final_morphs.name: 下唇巻き
final_morphs.rationale: Lower lip roll-in. Tiny (max 0.0090) but independent.

final_morphs.name: 驚き口開
final_morphs.rationale: Wide open, cos 0.98 with jawOpen. Extra.

final_morphs.name: 怒り口開
final_morphs.rationale: cos 1.00 with 悲しみ口開 - the emotion mouths are near-collinear. Extra.

final_morphs.name: 悲しみ口開
final_morphs.rationale: Extra.

final_morphs.name: 軽蔑口開
final_morphs.rationale: Extra.

final_morphs.name: 疑い口開
final_morphs.rationale: Extra.

final_morphs.name: 疲れ口開
final_morphs.rationale: Extra.

final_morphs.name: 噛み口開
final_morphs.rationale: cos 0.38 with jawOpen - genuinely distinct chew shape. Extra.

final_morphs.name: 口拡大１
final_morphs.rationale: The ONLY flex with real horizontal mouth control (corner outward +0.0514) plus a big jaw drop (-0.0559). Base for □ and 口横広げ.

final_morphs.name: 口拡大２
final_morphs.rationale: Medium widen/open, pulled back -0.0281 Z.

final_morphs.name: 喜び口閉
final_morphs.rationale: cos -0.99 with 喜び口開: it is the exact inverse half of the same slider. Alone it presses the lips up (+0.0119) and pulls the corners DOWN (-0.0073) - the strongest corner-down shape available. Kept as a hidden group member.

final_morphs.name: 驚き口閉
final_morphs.rationale: The one CLO that is NOT the inverse of its OP (cos -0.54, |CLO|/|OP| = 0.155). Small independent shape. Hidden.

final_morphs.name: 怒り口閉
final_morphs.rationale: cos -0.999 with 怒り口開. Alone: centre of the lower lip +0.0363 up, corners -0.0047 down = the closest thing to an MMD ∧. Hidden group member.

final_morphs.name: 笑顔口閉
final_morphs.rationale: cos -0.95 with 笑顔口開. Hidden group member.

final_morphs.name: 悲しみ口閉
final_morphs.rationale: cos -0.997 with 悲しみ口開. Hidden.

final_morphs.name: 軽蔑口閉
final_morphs.rationale: cos -0.987 with 軽蔑口開. Hidden.

final_morphs.name: 疑い口閉
final_morphs.rationale: cos -0.984 with 疑い口開. Hidden.

final_morphs.name: 悪い口閉
final_morphs.rationale: cos -0.95 with 悪い口開. Hidden.

final_morphs.name: 疲れ口閉
final_morphs.rationale: cos -0.997 with 疲れ口開. Hidden.

final_morphs.name: 噛み口閉
final_morphs.rationale: cos +0.25 with 噛み口開 - independent. Pulls both lips down (-0.0112 / -0.0123). Hidden group member for ▲.

A 45% お opening narrowed by 噛み口閉, which pulls the upper lip down -0.0112 and the lower lip down -0.0123 with the corners drawn slightly inward (-0.0017). This is an approximation: the source rig has no corner-down-while-open control. Zero-risk fallback if it reads wrong: group[jawOpen_o 0.45] alone.
Net lower-lip centre +0.0308 up, corners -0.0066 down = the inverted-V closed mouth. The two members are cos +0.89 so they reinforce rather than cancel.
口拡大１ at 80%: jaw -0.0447, corners +0.0411 outward, upper lip +0.0255 up - a wide rectangular opening. Full strength (1.0) is too extreme for a resting expression.

final_morphs.name: ん
final_morphs.rationale: Both lips rolled in plus a 30% lip press. The roll flexes alone are too small to see (max 0.0105 / 0.0090), so the press supplies the visible closure.

final_morphs.name: 口角上げ
final_morphs.rationale: Net corners +0.0071 up with only -0.0076 of jaw drop. There is no isolated mouthSmile_L/R flex in the source, so this is the closest achievable corner-only lift.

final_morphs.name: 口角下げ
final_morphs.rationale: Net corners -0.0081 down, centre +0.0073 up. Mirror of 口角上げ built from the inverse halves of the same two sliders.

final_morphs.name: 口横広げ
final_morphs.rationale: Net corner outward +0.0314 (the largest widening obtainable) with -0.0291 of jaw drop. 口拡大１ is the only source of horizontal mouth scale, and it cannot be widened without some opening.

dropped.name: まばたき２
dropped.reason: BIT-IDENTICAL to まばたき / biyan. Verified: identical 2544-entry vertex-index array (element-wise equal, not merely the same set) and max |offset difference| = 0.0 over all 2544x3 floats. It cannot produce a different face, so it is pure dead weight and it steals a VMD-addressable name. MMD has no standard まばたき２ anyway.

dropped.name: 強まばたき
dropped.reason: BROKEN in this outfit. It does not close the eyes: the upper/lower lash gap only goes from 0.1090 to 0.0596 (55% of neutral). What it actually does is translate the whole eyelid/lash island +0.441 in Z (into the skull) and squeeze it horizontally from width 0.574 to 0.286, i.e. it HIDES the real eyes. In the school reference this pairs with the 表情 decal mesh (TD_BeanieEye / TD_SymbolEye / TD_EggEyes) that swaps in cartoon eyes; the Fashion 1 mesh has no 表情 material (materials are 髪_02 目影 顔 睫毛 瞳 目HL 衣装1 衣装2), so at weight 1.0 the character simply loses her eyelashes into her head. Also note it is the only eye morph that disturbs 顔 above y=19.55 by 89.4 units of motion.

unavailable_standard_morphs.name: ω
unavailable_standard_morphs.reason: The 'cat mouth' double-hump needs independent control of the two halves of the upper lip. The source rig is jaw-driven: every mouth flex except mouthPucker/mouthFunnel/mouthRoll* is cos>=0.9 collinear with jawOpen, and none of them creates a mid-lip peak. Any group would be a lie.

unavailable_standard_morphs.name: 星目
unavailable_standard_morphs.reason: Requires replacement star-shaped iris geometry. In the school reference this lives on the 表情 decal material (TD_SymbolEye, 2601 offsets). The Fashion 1 uemodel exports only TD_EyesClo out of the whole TD_* family and has no 表情 material, so there is no geometry to reveal.

unavailable_standard_morphs.name: はぁと
unavailable_standard_morphs.reason: Same as 星目 - needs the TD_EggEyes / TD_SymbolEye decal island, which is absent from player_076_shinku_fashion1_skin.uemodel.

unavailable_standard_morphs.name: 照れ
unavailable_standard_morphs.reason: A blush needs either blush geometry, a second UV set with a blush patch, or a material morph that fades in a blush texture. The face material (顔) has one texture and no blush layer, and there is no TD_* blush flex in the 88 exported flexes. Faking it with a red diffuse tint on the whole 顔 material would redden the entire face.

unavailable_standard_morphs.name: 涙
unavailable_standard_morphs.reason: Requires tear geometry under the eyes. No such island exists in this mesh and no flex (TD_Sweaty exists only in the school model) touches one.

unavailable_standard_morphs.name: がーん
unavailable_standard_morphs.reason: Needs the vertical shock lines / TD_Veins style decal, which is part of the school model's 表情 material and absent here.

unavailable_standard_morphs.name: 眉びっくり as 上
unavailable_standard_morphs.reason: Not a missing morph, a clarification: EB_Surprised_01 is an ARCHED raise (inner +0.034, outer +0.107) and is NOT interchangeable with the flat 上 raise, so 上 is built from EB_UD_L/R instead.

left_right_signs.EL_Happy_r_CLO: all 1277 offsets X>0 -> character LEFT -> ウィンク
left_right_signs.biyan_L: all X>0 -> character LEFT -> ウィンク２

left_right_signs.EB_Rotate_01/02: 01: X>0 char left -> 眉回転左; 02 mirrors -> 眉回転右

remeasured_on_this_mesh.duplicates: biyan1 ≡ biyan bit-identical (same 2544-entry index array, max |offset diff| = 0.0) -> まばたき２ dropped
remeasured_on_this_mesh.TD_EyesClo: moves the 1034 strong upper-lid vertices only 17% (median ratio 0.174) as far as biyan - does NOT close the eye on this mesh either -> 強まばたき dropped as broken
remeasured_on_this_mesh.negative_bakes: brow-lash rest clearance 0.1269; EB_UD both @ -0.5 keeps 0.0526 (adopted for 下), @ -1.0 collapses to 0.0122 (rejected, P17); EB_Rotate @ -1.0 keeps 0.0962 (adopted for 眉頭左/右)
